PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION AGENDA
  THURSDAY, OCTOBER 17, 2024
  1800 EAST WARDLOW ROAD
  BOARD ROOM, 9:00 AM

Gina Maguire, President  Naiomi Rainey, Commissioner
Kevin Scott, Vice President  Robert Shannon, Commissioner
Gloria Cordero, Secretary

B. Anatole Falagán, General Manager  Marsha Yasuda, Deputy City Attorney

 CALL TO ORDER

 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

 ROLL CALL

 REGULAR AGENDA

 1.  24-55345  Recommendation to approve October 3, 2024 Board meeting minutes.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 2.  24-55346  Recommendation to approve Transfer of Funds for October 17, 2024.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 3.  24-55347  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to adopt and approve the final
  Initial Study Mitigated Negative Declaration (IS/MND); adopt the Mitigation
  Monitoring and Reporting Program (MMRP); approve filing of a Notice of
  Determination with the Los Angeles County Clerk; and execute the appropriate
  environmental documents related to the Los Angeles Department of Water
  and Power Haynes Generating Station Sewer Pipeline Project (SC-0442).

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 4.  24-55348  Recommendation to authorize the General Manager to increase the Long Beach
  Public Utilities Department’s grant funding share from $53,000 to $126,816 for the
  development and implementation of an Automated Earthquake Early Warning
  System.

  Suggested Action:  Approve recommendation.

 PUBLIC COMMENT

 Opportunity to address the Utilities Commission on non-agenda items. Each speaker is limited to
 three minutes to make their comments unless extended by the Board.
